tha-ap199:1.1: Tindukadāyaka.] Giriduggañ caro āsiṃ makkaṭo thāmavegiko / phalinaṃ tindukaṃ disvā Buddhaseṭṭham anussariṃ. // //
tha-ap199:2.1: Nikkhipitvā katipāhaṃ viciniṃ lokanāyakaṃ / pasannacitto sumano Siddhatthan tibhavantaguṃ. // //
tha-ap199:3.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro / khīṇāsavasahassehi agacchi mama santike. // // Pāmujjaṃ
tha-ap199:4.1: janayitvāna phalahattho upāgamiṃ / paṭiggahesi bhagavā sabbaññū vadataṃ varo. // //
tha-ap199:5.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap199:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tindukadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
